newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 17.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
* Federal investigators said the government overpaid last year by $23 billion or 14 percent of the money spent in the standard Medicare program.
* Details of the life of Andrew Cunanan emerge as authorities conduct a manhunt for the suspected killer of Gianni Versace.
* United Nations Secretary General Kofi Annan said he plans to restructure the organization's management.
* Agents seized documents in six states at dozens of hospitals and offices operated by the Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp.
* A CIA official told a Senate committee that John Huang's briefings on Asia were part of routine proceedures at the Commerce Department.
* In the last 18 months, more than 2,000 victims of South African apartheid-era brutality have told their stories to the country's Truth and Reconciliation Commission.
